messages:
Iris: Quick sync on the SparkLoop microexperiment: 30m launch demo + 72h activation nudges. Core idea: low-friction claim (50 credits) + role-based prompt starter pack. Goal = lift first-use within 3 days by 15%.
Diego: Good goal. Landing flow should surface a single recommended template based on role and a 1-click "Use with credits" button.
Sam: Role options: Engineer / PM / Content. Starter templates = triage-bug, roadmap-summary, ad-copy. I'll draft examples.
Nia: Measurement: define 'activated' = request tokens >=45 OR template_applied=true AND request_count>=1. Track event 'spark_activation'.
Carlos: For credits: attach promo code SPARK50, expire 14d, block multi-claim by same email or device fingerprint. Add soft IP throttle. I'll handle infra.
Priya: Email drip: immediate claim confirmation, 24h quickstart with 2 sample prompts, 48h activation nudge with inline CTA to run a sample. A/B test CTA verbs ("Try" vs "Run").
Iris: Also want a short benchmark narrative for the demo: "How teams reduce time-to-first-use with targeted starter prompts and credit nudges" keep it non-technical.
Diego: Creative: 20s clip showing claim -> run template -> snippet of output. Social copy should emphasize "instant credits" and "starter prompts".
Sam: I'll include micro-guides in the prompt pack: one-liners + 2 dos/don'ts per template. ETA Mon EOD.
Nia: Analytics: cohort = utm_campaign:sparkloop_q2. Compare to baseline cohort of last 30 days. Key metrics: claim_rate, activation_rate_72h, retention_7d.
Carlos: Security note: add captcha if we detect >5 claims from same ip within 12h. Looping security for signoff.
Priya: Routing rule: webinar registrants who select "contact me" AND company_size>=10 route to sales, else tag 'spark-seed' and go self-serve. ops-bot can create rule.
ops-bot: Created routing rule #2910: tag=spark-seed. Predicate: want_contact==true AND company_size>=10 -> sales-queue. Details: https://internal.ops/rules/2910
Iris: Owners: Landing+claims=Carlos, Templates=Sam, Emails=Priya, Creative=Diego, Analytics=Nia, Routing=ops-bot. Dry run Tue 4pm PT.
Diego: Landing links need UTM + amp-experiment tag exp_sparkloop_q2. Nia please set buckets.
Nia: Setting A/B buckets now. Experiment id: exp_sparkloop_q2.
Sam: Snippet for claim API (dev): ```js
fetch('/api/promo/claim',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({code:'SPARK50'})})
```
Carlos: Branch open and basic integration tests passing. Will request review tomorrow.
Priya: I'll draft two email variants and share in drive by Mon noon. One is benefit-first, one is how-to-first.
Iris: Can we also include a tiny in-app sample prompt with prefilled variables to lower friction? Diego, can creative record a quick walkthrough?
Diego: Yep, recording scheduled Mon 9am.
Carlos: Security asking for fraud heuristics doc  will add notes on rate limits and captcha triggers.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run Tue 3:30pm -> #marketing and #eng-oncall.
Iris: Final ask: drop all final assets in /shared/marketing/sparkloop by Mon 2pm PT so eng has time to QA. Thanks everyone :rocket:
Nia: I'll add dashboard tiles and a cohort report for the run.
Sam: Template pack will include README and example prompts in a zip.
Priya: On email timing A/B i'll try 24h vs 36h for the second nudge.
Iris: Locking on plan. Meet at dry run.
eng-bot: CI pipeline scheduled for landing branch. Smoke test Tue 3pm.
